description: Search MercadoLibre Mexico listings by keyword or URL, or fetch full product details by URL or item ID. Filter by condition, price and shipping, and paginate through results.

country.description: MercadoLibre country site. Only Mexico (MX) is supported.
country.title: Country

freeShippingOnly.description: Return only listings that advertise free shipping.
freeShippingOnly.title: Free shipping only

includeDetails.description: Open each search result's product page to add description, stock, sold count and seller fields. Slower and uses more requests.
includeDetails.title: Include product details

maxItems.description: Maximum records to return. Search results paginate automatically.
maxItems.title: Max Items

mode.description: Search listings, or fetch details for specific products.
mode.title: What to scrape

productUrls.description: MercadoLibre Mexico product URLs or item IDs (for example MLM1234567890). Required for the product-details mode.
productUrls.title: Product URLs or IDs

searchQuery.description: Keyword to search for. Use this or Start URLs with the search mode.
searchQuery.title: Search Query

startUrls.description: MercadoLibre Mexico search or category listing URLs. When set, they replace the keyword; the filter and sort fields still apply.
startUrls.title: Start URLs

title: MercadoLibre Mexico Marketplace Scraper Input
